verdicts.decision_note: The reported mismatch establishes the implementation-relevant acceptance behavior that the BigQuery-backed gross revenue figure must match its source figure.
This is the first concrete failure: testing showed the BigQuery gross revenue figure did not match the source figure.
The client adds an implementation-relevant acceptance condition: figure matching must be evaluated with the applicable date range selected; no prior attribute becomes obsolete.
This is the first concrete verification after the apparent mismatch: the client confirms that the gross revenue figures match when the date range is selected.
